entry.title: Generate truly random seed words using only dice or playing cards
entry.summary: Creating one's own seed words offers an alternative to relying on a device, presenting a potentially empowering approach for users who prefer manual control over their digital security. A practical suggestion involves providing a brief, clear worked example that demystifies the process for users unfamiliar with technical jargon or procedures. Additionally, emphasizing the importance of practicing with an empty wallet before committing real funds can significantly enhance user confidence and safety. This practice ensures that users can effectively restore access to their assets in case they need to recover their wallet, thereby reducing the risk of loss due to errors in handling seed words. Such guidance would make the overall process more accessible to non-technical users, fostering broader adoption and better security practices among individuals managing their digital currencies or other secure digital assets.
